## Research change

### Hypothesis or archive purpose

<!-- What uncertainty does this change address? -->

### Evidence

- [ ] Raw result or source receipt is included.
- [ ] Model/version and timestamp are recorded.
- [ ] Observed, inferred and speculative statements are separated.
- [ ] Alternative explanations and confounders are documented.

### Reproducibility

- [ ] The command or procedure is recorded.
- [ ] Secrets, caches, weights and private state are excluded.
- [ ] API limits and failures are preserved rather than hidden.

### Documentation

- [ ] Evidence matrix updated.
- [ ] Hypothesis tracker updated.
- [ ] Master report updated if the conclusion changes.
